goal: Try to make the command bar move under your cursor (#410): inside and outside your town, watch the buttons as pawns walk in and out of reach, as Feed Residents becomes enabled or disabled, and after crafting or buying a tool; click quickly twice on buttons and report any time a click lands on a different command than intended, with screenshots. Also check the Talk button shows the pawn's standing but not its traits.

findings.title: Pawn leaving reach drops Buy Pickaxe/Buy Axe into Talk's slot; a click meant for Talk spent 299 coins
findings.detail: Inside my own town the Craft group (Buy Axe/Buy Pickaxe) is laid out after the People group, and rows stack upward. With a pawn in reach Talk is at (10-313, 414) and the Buy buttons sit on the Order row above; with no pawn, the Buy buttons fall to y=414 starting at x=10, exactly where Talk was. I hovered Talk at (65,414), the pawn walked out of reach, I clicked, and got 'Bought 1 pickaxe for 299 coins from Frank Thompson' (coins 348 -> 49). The purchase is not confirmed. The reverse happens too: hovering Buy Axe at (65,414) with no pawn, a pawn walking in put 'Talk to Victor Taylor (Stranger)' under the cursor (shots/pawn_in_over_buy.png). Expected: putting the Craft group last stops it moving when a Craft button is removed, but because it comes after People it moves every time a pawn comes or goes. It needs its own fixed slot, or the People rows need to sit above it.
findings.repro: pt start --profile beyond-nations --game-dir /root/beyond-nations --seed 109 --stage-settlement; Start, Begin; click Enter Settlement (74,476); with 339 coins Buy Axe/Buy Pickaxe show; pt move 65 414 and wait for a pawn to walk out of reach (pt state nearest pawn > 5m); pt click 65 414

findings.title: Double-click on Enter Settlement withdraws settlement funds (Withdraw Funds takes its slot inside)
findings.detail: Outside, Enter Settlement is the first button on the bottom row at (10-137, 476). Inside my own town, the Nation group comes first, so Withdraw Funds is in that slot and Exit Settlement is third. A quick double-click on Enter Settlement entered the town and then ran 'Withdrew 9 coins from settlement' (coins 339 -> 348). I expected Exit Settlement in Enter's slot (they are the same toggle), or the second click to do nothing.
findings.repro: pt start ... --stage-settlement; be outside own town within 50m; pt click 74 476; pt click 74 476; pt events 3

findings.title: Double-click on Exit Settlement plants a sapling in the town square, with no message
findings.detail: Exit Settlement is at (314-441, 476) inside town; outside, Plant Sapling sits in that slot. When I double-clicked Exit, saplings went 2 -> 1 and a tree appeared next to the well in the town square. The status line only said 'Exited settlement.', so nothing tells the player why a tree is there.
findings.repro: carry saplings; inside own town pt click 377 476; pt click 377 476

findings.title: When a caravan leaves, the Trade row disappears and every pawn/craft row drops a row
findings.detail: Outside town near a Fortressshire caravan, the rows were Place / Escort Caravan / Talk+Gift / Order+Craft Axe. When the caravan moved off, the Trade row vanished and every row above it shifted down by one: Talk 414->445, Order 383->414, Craft Axe (337,383)->(337,414). A click aimed at Talk lands on 'Order <pawn>: Gather Wood', and my double-click on Craft Axe hit empty space. The People row starting a new row stops sideways shifts, but rows still stack upward, so a lower group going away moves everything above it.
findings.repro: pt start ... --stage-settlement; Teleport Home while a caravan is by the town; note the Talk position; wait for the caravan to leave

findings.title: Build House / Build Farm buttons are removed (not disabled) when the town has no room, so their neighbours slide left
findings.detail: When the town grew from 7 to 10 buildings, Build House disappeared and Build Farm and Send Caravan slid left into its slot. At 11 buildings Build Farm also went, and Send Caravan moved from x~450 to x~297. The code disables buttons that are 'only unavailable for now', but a Build button for a full town is removed, which moves the Trade buttons after it.
findings.repro: stay in own town while the town grows (stage-settlement town reaches 11 buildings in a few game minutes); watch the Purchase Food row

findings.title: Inventory Info panel jumps from the left column to the middle of the screen whenever pawn rows appear
findings.detail: In town with no pawn in reach, Inventory Info is in the left column (x~10). When a pawn steps into reach and the bar gains its rows, the panel moves to x~220, y~195, over the 3D view, and it goes back when the pawn leaves. It also hops between in-town and out-of-town layouts.
findings.repro: stand in own town; compare screenshots with and without a pawn within 5m

findings.title: Objective 7 progress bar text clipped on the left ('pers 10/10 • Buildings 2/2')
findings.detail: The progress bar for 'Reach the Village era' cuts off the start of its text, so it reads 'pers 10/10 • Buildings 2/2'.
findings.repro: play until objective 7 'Reach the Village era'

verdict: The #410 command bar is much steadier than before. Widths no longer change with pawn names, counts or tiers, the Drastic row stays where it is, Craft Axe goes last so a double-click on it does nothing, and Talk shows only the standing ('Talk to X (Stranger)'), with the traits in the tooltip. But the bar still moves under the cursor in three ways: the Craft/Buy group comes after the pawn rows, rows stack upward so a disappearing lower row (caravan, pawns) moves everything above it, and Enter/Exit Settlement are not in the same slot. All of these produced real misclicks, the worst being an unconfirmed 299-coin pickaxe purchase. Feed Residents stayed in a fixed, disabled slot the whole time, but no resident got hungry in about 5 game minutes, so I never saw it switch to enabled.
